title: Manabu Kosaka's Handmade Paper Sculptures
summary: A showcase of Manabu Kosaka's handmade paper sculptures, an art project featuring intricate paper craft works displayed on a personal website, which gained notable attention on Hacker News with 125 points.
problem_solved: Provides a platform for showcasing handmade paper art and sculptural work to a broader audience.
why_valuable: Demonstrates the artistry and craftsmanship possible with paper as a medium, inspiring appreciation for traditional handcraft techniques.
